Agency News National Gujarat Dy CM joins folk dance during ‘Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas’ rally in Valsad By IANS - November 15, 2026 Spread the love Tweet Gujarat Dy CM joins folk dance during ‘Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas’ rally in Valsad Valsad: Gujarat Deputy Chief Minister Harsh Sanghavi on Sunday joined members of the tribal community in a traditional dance during a rally at Nanapondha in Valsad district to mark the 151st birth anniversary of tribal freedom fighter Bhagwan Birsa Munda, celebrated as ‘Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas’.

items.title: TN: 4,100 police personnel deployed as Tiruchendur temple prepares for ‘Soorasamharam’
paras: --> Home Mangalorean News Local News Gulf News Kannada News Recipes Fit & Fun Sports Health Entertainment Other News Mangalorean Star Obituary Congratulations Sponsored Classifieds Best Hospitals & Institutions Best Schools & Colleges Your Thoughts Old Mangalorean Regional National Business General My Opinion Literature Advertise With Us World Home Agency News TN: 4,100 police personnel deployed as Tiruchendur temple prepares for ‘Soorasamharam’ Agency News National TN: 4,100 police personnel deployed as Tiruchendur temple prepares for ‘Soorasamharam’ By IANS - November 15, 2026 Spread the love Tweet TN: 4,100 police personnel deployed as Tiruchendur temple prepares for ‘Soorasamharam’ Tiruchendur: Thousands of devotees gathered at the Subramaniya Swamy Temple in Tamil Nadu’s Tiruchendur on Sunday for ‘Soorasamharam’, the centrepiece of the annual Kanda Sashti festival, with around 4,100 police personnel deployed to ensure security and regulate crowds.
